basic_info.description: Location, Location, Location ~ Put your own signature on this lovely Victorian home - Large foyer, Formal Living room with decorative fireplace and a Formal Dining room, hardwood floors & period moldings. Kitchen w/ breakfast room has direct access to rear garden. Guest bath off kitchen. Bedroom level has 3 bedrooms (front large bedroom w/ fireplace & wet sink). 4th & 5th bedroom, study area on top level. 1 car garage, with large unfinished area on ground level which features a separate entrance.
